ios.afterPhaseName: Bundle React Native code and images
ios.shellScript:
set -e
if [ "$CODEMAGIC_PATCH_SKIP_BUILD_FINGERPRINT" = 1 ]; then
  rm -f "${TARGET_BUILD_DIR:?}/${UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH:?}/CodemagicPatchBuild.json"
  echo "warning: CODEMAGIC_PATCH_SKIP_BUILD_FINGERPRINT=1 opts out: no CodemagicPatchBuild.json for this build. This disables the whole metadata file, and with it embedded-baseline identification for this binary."
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING" = YES ]; then
  echo "error: Codemagic Patch build metadata cannot run with ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = YES, which keeps a build phase from reading the project. Set ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = NO for this target. To build without metadata, set CODEMAGIC_PATCH_SKIP_BUILD_FINGERPRINT=1."
  exit 1
fi
SDK_PARENT="$(cd "${PROJECT_ROOT:-$PROJECT_DIR/..}" && pwd -P)"
while [ ! -e "$SDK_PARENT/node_modules/@codemagic/react-native-patch/package.json" ] && [ "$SDK_PARENT" != / ]; do
  SDK_PARENT="$(dirname "$SDK_PARENT")"
done
PHASE_BODY="$SDK_PARENT/node_modules/@codemagic/react-native-patch/build-tools/native/build-metadata-phase.sh"
if [ ! -f "$PHASE_BODY" ]; then
  echo "error: Codemagic Patch build metadata cannot find build-tools/native/build-metadata-phase.sh of @codemagic/react-native-patch in a node_modules directory at or above ${PROJECT_ROOT:-$PROJECT_DIR/..}. Install the project's dependencies, upgrade an SDK that predates this step, or delete the 'Codemagic Patch build metadata' build phase if the project no longer uses the SDK. To build without metadata, set CODEMAGIC_PATCH_SKIP_BUILD_FINGERPRINT=1."
  exit 1
fi
exec /bin/bash "$PHASE_BODY" --integration {{integration}}
